text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
MWAAAHAHAHA! Wicked Windy is<n>back in tip-top
shape!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I visited home on my day off<n>yesterday! And then,
and then!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mom and everyone praised me a<n>bunch! Said I was
workin' real hard!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And then Dad made heaps of my<n>favorite food! It
was the best day off<n>ever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It appears Shinko Windy thoroughly<n>enjoyed her
break and feels<n>revitalized!
